# A garden gnome 0.66 m tall, facing the camera: dark boots, a blue coat, a skin face, a white
# beard, a tall red hat. Origin on the ground under it. Generated by make_env.py.
new
material new Boot --base-color 0.247 0.157 0.196 --no-slot
material new Coat --base-color 0.016 0.518 0.820 --no-slot
material new Face --base-color 0.894 0.651 0.447 --no-slot
material new Beard --base-color 1.000 1.000 1.000 --no-slot
material new Hat --base-color 0.898 0.231 0.267 --no-slot
add mesh cube --name Boots --size 1 --location 0.0000 0.0100 0.0450
scale 0.3000 0.2200 0.0900
apply --scale
material assign Boot
add mesh cone --name Coat --vertices 6 --radius1 0.19 --radius2 0.12 --depth 0.26 --location 0 0 0.21
material assign Coat
add mesh cube --name Face --size 1 --location 0.0000 -0.0100 0.4000
scale 0.2000 0.2000 0.1400
apply --scale
material assign Face
add mesh cone --name Beard --vertices 4 --radius1 0.04 --radius2 0.15 --depth 0.18 --location 0 -0.07 0.36 --rotation 0 0 45
scale 1 0.7 1
material assign Beard
add mesh cone --name Hat --vertices 6 --radius1 0.15 --radius2 0.02 --depth 0.24 --location 0 0 0.58
material assign Hat
select all
shade flat
export gnome.glb
